2b1(rgyud): ni ra gnas pa dang //'byung po'i ma mo 'phrog ma dang //sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang //tshangs pa'i dbang dang lha dbang dang //klu dbang mthu chen rnams dang ni//mi 'am ci dbang lha min dbang //de bzhin nam mkha' lding dbang rnams//sde dang stobs dang bzhon pa

3a1(rgyud): @#//byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mdzes pa'i tog ces bya ba/sngon gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur byas pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po la rim gro byas pa zhig gnas pa de 'di snyam du sems te/rgyu 
3a2(rgyud): gang dang rkyen gang gis/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa 'di lta ste/lo brgyad cu zhig thub ste/'di ltar sku tshe thung snyam nas/de yang 'di snyam du sems te/bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du/rgyu gnyis dang rkyen gnyis kyis tshe ring bar 'gyur te/gnyis gang zhe na 
3a3(rgyud): 'di lta ste/srog gcod pa spangs pa dang /kha zas rab tu sbyin pa'o zhes gsungs te/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thab pas ni/bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa mang po nas/srog gcod pa spangs bar gyur pa nas/dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam 
3a4(rgyud): gyi bar du yang dag par blangs par gyur/zas dang phyi nang gi dngos po rnams sems can dag la yongs su btang ste/tha na rang gi lus kyi sha dang khrag dang rus pa dang rkang gis kyang sems can lkogs pa rnams tshim par mdzad na/zas gzhan gyis lta ci smos snyam mo//
3a5(rgyud): de nas skyes bu dam pa de sangs rgyas la song ba'i yid la byed pa dag las/'di lta bu'i tshul gyis bsam pa 'di dag sems pa na/de'i khyim yangs shing rgya che la bai DUr+ya sngon po las grub pa/lha'i rin po che du mas spras pa/de bzhin gshegs pas kha dog bsgyur ba/
3a6(rgyud): lha'i las 'das pa'i spos kyis khyab par gyur to//khyim de'i phyogs bzhi nas lha'i rin po che'i khri bzhi byung bar gyur te/khri de dag las kyang lha'i ras bcos bu'i rin po che'i thugs rnams bting ba dag byung bar gyur to//khri de dag las kyang lha'i me tog padam rin po che du mas 
3a7(rgyud): spras pa/de bzhin gshegs bas kha dog bsgyur ba dag byung ngo //padam de dag las kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhi byung bar gyur te/shar phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa byung /lho phyogs nas ni de bzhin ga shegs pa rin chen tog byung /nub 
3b1(rgyud): phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med byung /byad phyogs nas ni de bzhin gshes pa rnga sgra byung ste/seng ge'i khri de dag las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag byung ma thag tu/de nas de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po sprang ba chen pos byung /'gyur 
3b2(rgyud): to|/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar dang /phyogs bcu kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ba dang /phyogs bcu kun du 'jig rten gyi khams gang gA'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar dag snang bas khyab par gyur/lha'i me tog dag gi char yang 
3b3(rgyud): bab|lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra yang byung ngo//sangs rgyas kyi mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sems can thams cad kyang lha'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur te/sems can dbang po ma tshang ba rnams ni dbang po thams cad dang ldan par gyur/
3b4(rgyud): sems can dmus long dag ni mig gis gzugs rnams mthong /sems can 'on pa dag ni rna bas sgra rnams thos/sems can smyos pa dag ni dran pa so sor rnyed/sems can sems g.yeng ba dag ni sems mi g.yeng bar gyur/sems can sgren mo dag ni gos 
3b5(rgyud): bgos par gyur/sems can bkres pa dag ni lto 'grangs par gyur/sems can sgom pa dag ni skom ngoms par gyur/sems can nad kyis btab pa dag ni nad dang bral bar gyur/lus kyi dbang po nyams pa dag ni dbang po rnams tshang bar gyur te/'jig rten du ngo mtshar 
3b6(rgyud): rmad du byung ba'i chos rnams rgya cher byung bar gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag mthong nas ngo mtshar rmad du gyur te/de tshim zhing mgul yi rangs shing rab tu dga' ste/dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/sangs 
3b7(rgyud): rgyas bcom ldan 'das de da ga ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/de dag rnams rjes su dran la/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i yon tan rjes su dran zhing /bcom ldan 'das shAkya thob pa'i sku tshe'i tshad la the tshom za bar gyur te/
4a1(rgyud): @#//bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa 'di ltar lo brgyad cu zhig thub ste sku tshe thung ba 'di ji lta bu/'di ci zhig snyam du bsam pa de sems shing 'dug par gyur to//de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis dgongs shing mkhyen bzhin du/byang chub sems dpa' 
4a2(rgyud): mdzes pa'i tog de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//rigs kyi bu khyod 'di snyam du/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thubapa 'di ltar sku tshe thung ngo snyam du ma sems shig/de ci'i phyir zhe na/rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dag bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 
4a3(rgyud): rgyas rnams ma gtogs par/lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang /bdud dang bcas pa dang /tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang /dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shAkya 
4a4(rgyud): thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad kyi mtha'/phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i bar du yang rtogs par nus pa ded kyis su yang ma mthong ngo //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bshad pa brjod ma thag tu/de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i bu 'dod pa na 
4a5(rgyud): spyod pa rnams dang /gzugs na spyod pa rnams dang /klu dang /gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang /lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po'i bar dag dang /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma 'dus nas/byang chub 
4a6(rgyud): sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gi khyim der lhags so//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la/bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bshad ba tshigs su bcad de mdor bka' stsal pa/rgya mtsho'i chu rnams thams cad kyi//
4a7(rgyud): rigs pa dag ni bgrang bar nus//shAkya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad//sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so//ri rab rnams ni thams cad kyang //phra rab rdul du bgrang bar nus//shAkya thab pa'i sku tshe'i tshad//susakyang bgrang bar mi nus so//sa la gang dag yod pa yi//
4b1(rgyud): rab tu phra rdul ji snyed pa//thams cad bgrang bar nus srid kyi//rgyal ba'i sku tshe'i tshad mi nus//gal te la las nam mkha' la//snang 'ga' zhig gis dpag 'dod kyang //shAkya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad//sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 
4b2(rgyud): 'di srid bzhugs//bskal pa dag ni 'di snyed cig/bskal pa bye ba brgya dag ces//grangs ni rnyed par mi rung ngo //gang phyir de yi rgyu dang ni//rkyen yang rnam pa gnyis yin te//sdig pa'i 'tshe ba spangs pa dang //kha zas mang po byin pa ste//de phyir bdag nyid

5a3(rgyud): nyon cig/kye lits+tsha bI gzho nu gser 'od dam pa'i mngon ni/de ltar shes par dka' zhing rtogs par dka' bas na/kho bo cog mtha' 'khob kyi gling gi bram ze rnams ni/gang bcangs pa na sems can rnams myur du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po 'thob par 'gyur ba'i ring

5b3(rgyud): ba//de tshe ring bsrel yodapar 'gyur//nam zhig bong bu bde 'gyur la//mchu dmar bim pa 'drar gyur cing //glu gar rnams la mkhas gyur pa//de tshe ring bsrel ba yod par 'gyur//nam zhi ga 'ug pa bya rog rnams//dben par dong nas rtse ba dang //phan tshun

5b5(rgyud): bcas//thang la byung ste 'gro ba na//de tshe ring bsrel yod par 'gyur//nam shig bya ni 'ug pa yis//ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang ba//mchu la thogs te 'gro 'gyur ba//de tshe ring bsrel yid par 'gyur//slob dpon lung ston pa bram ze kauN+Di n+yas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag thos nas/
5b6(rgyud): lits+tsha bI gzhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba la tshigs su bcad pa 'di ngag gis slar smras pa/legs so legs so gzhon nu mchog/rgyal ba'i sras po tshig po che//dpa' zhing thabs la mkhas ldan pa//lung bstan pa ni dam pa thob//'jig rten mgon po

6a1(rgyud): @#//cad yang dag byung //sangs rgyas thams cad kha dog mtshungs//'di ni sangs rgyas chos nyid yin//bcom ldan 'das ni bcos ma min//de bzhin gshegs pa ma skyes te//rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i sku//sprul pa'i sku ni ston par mdzad//drang srong chen po'i
